title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Are you a creative, data-driven marketer looking to make a real impact? This is an exciting opportunity to join a nationally recognised engineering products and industrial services business with a strong UK presence and an extensive network of branches nationwide.

As a market-leading organisation experiencing continued growth, the company is investing heavily in its brand, digital presence, and customer engagement strategy. You'll have the chance to take ownership of innovative marketing campaigns, work closely with commercial teams across the business, and play a key role in driving lead generation, brand awareness, and business growth.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an ambitious Digital Marketing Executive who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to be part of a business where their ideas, creativity, and expertise will make a tangible difference. Please note this role is 5 days onsite.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Plan, manage, and execute end-to-end digital marketing campaigns.
- Create engaging content across various channels including social media, email marketing, websites, and digital advertising.
- Manage and expand the company's social media presence.
- Develop both organic and paid campaigns to enhance lead generation and customer engagement.
- Support SEO initiatives and assist with PPC campaign management and optimisation.
- Maintain and develop website content and landing pages.
- Design marketing materials using Adobe Creative Suite and Canva.
- Monitor campaign performance using analytics tools, providing regular reporting and insights.
- Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing activities with commercial objectives.
- Support product launches, exhibitions, company events, and new site openings.
- Create and manage photography and video content, ensuring brand consistency across all marketing communications and customer touchpoints.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Minimum of 2 years' experience in a Digital Marketing Executive role or similar.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels including SEO, PPC, email marketing, social media, content marketing, and website management.
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and strong Canva skills.
- Excellent copywriting and content creation abilities.
- Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Commercially minded with a results-focused approach.

Desirable Experience:
- Background in B2 B, industrial, engineering, manufacturing, or technical environments.
- Experience with marketing automation or CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Mailchimp, or Salesforce.
- Skills in photography, videography, and basic video editing.
- Understanding of Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO) and experience managing Google Ads and/or LinkedIn advertising campaigns.

Benefits:
- 20 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to purchase up to 5 additional days.
- Company pension scheme.
- Wellbeing support and employee rewards platform.
- Paid volunteering day.
- Employee referral and Cycle to Work schemes.
- Full training and ongoing professional development.

Apply now!

title: Direct Response Marketing Specialist
description:
Direct Response Marketing Specialist
Aylesford, Kent 40,000 Permanent Full Time 40 Hours Flexible Hours
Are you a data-driven marketer who loves seeing campaigns deliver real results? Looking for a role where you'll combine creativity with analytics whilst working for one of the UK's fastest-growing ecommerce brands?
Our client is looking for a Direct Response Marketing Specialist to join their growing marketing team, supporting the delivery and optimisation of Direct Response TV (DRTV) and print advertising campaigns. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys analysing campaign performance, testing new ideas and making a genuine commercial impact within a fast-paced business.
The Role Working closely with internal teams and external agency partners, you'll play a key role in launching, monitoring and optimising direct response campaigns across TV and print. This position offers an exciting mix of campaign management, creative development and performance analysis.

Responsibilities include:
- Supporting the day-to-day delivery of DRTV and print advertising campaigns
- Assisting with campaign planning, launches and creative development
- Coordinating campaign activity to ensure projects are delivered on time
- Working alongside media agencies to optimise TV airtime and print placements
- Running A/B tests and creative experiments to improve campaign performance
- Monitoring campaign KPIs including ROAS, response rates and conversions
- Analysing performance data to identify opportunities for improvement
- Assisting with campaign budgeting and spend tracking
- Building strong relationships with agency partners
- Keeping up to date with industry trends and best practice in direct response marketing.

About You You'll be analytical, commercially minded and excited by performance marketing. You enjoy working with data but also have a creative side, allowing you to develop campaigns that generate measurable results.
You'll ideally have:
- Experience within direct response, performance or campaign marketing
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data
- Knowledge of KPIs including ROAS, CPA, attribution and conversion funnels
- Experience working with agencies or external marketing partners
- Excellent organisation and project management skills
- A proactive attitude with a passion for testing, optimisation and continuous improvement
- Strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.

Benefits
- Salary of 40,000
- Private healthcare
- Flexible working hours
- Minimum 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Birthday off every year
- Buy & sell holiday scheme
- Paid sick leave
- Enhanced maternity & paternity pay
- Company pension
- Free breakfast every morning
- Free EV charging
- Free monthly car wash
- Staff discounts and free products
- Casual dress code
- Regular team events and charity fundraising
- Cycle to work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes.

Apply Today This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the UK's fastest-growing ecommerce businesses, where you'll have the chance to shape high-profile marketing campaigns, develop your skills and contribute directly to commercial growth. If you're passionate about performance marketing and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
I am seeking a proactive, creative, and ambitious Marketing Executive to join a growing organisation within the financial services sector. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated marketer with strong copywriting skills and a passion for creating engaging content across multiple channels. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting and delivering marketing activity, working across content, social media, digital marketing, campaigns, events, and analytics.

This role will suit someone who is organised, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills, a willingness to learn, and a positive, proactive attitude are essential. There is a path for great career progression and growth within the role and is perfect for someone at a junior level looking to expand their skill set even further with a great 'go get it' attitude!

Key Responsibilities
- Create engaging content for websites, blogs, email campaigns, social media, and marketing materials.
- Produce SEO-focused content, including website pages, FAQs, metadata, and digital assets.
- Ensure all content is accurate, compliant, and aligned with brand guidelines.
- Create and adapt marketing assets, including social media graphics, web banners, brochures, and digital advertisements.
- Support the creation and editing of video content for social media and digital channels.
- Develop, schedule, and manage content across social media platforms.
- Assist with the planning, filming, and delivery of social media campaigns and video content.
- Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across digital, email, social media, advertising, and events.
- Support website updates, content management, and optimisation initiatives.
- Assist with SEO performance monitoring, keyword tracking, and content improvement strategies.
- Coordinate marketing support for events, webinars, and industry exhibitions.
- Assist with the delivery of email marketing campaigns and customer nurture journeys.
- Monitor campaign, website, social media, and email performance.
- Produce regular marketing reports and provide insights to support future marketing activity.
- Contribute ideas and recommendations to improve marketing performance, engagement, and lead generation.
- Effectively manage multiple projects and priorities while meeting deadlines.

What we need from you:
- Excellent copywriting and written communication skills. ( with SEO desirable)
- Social media management experience
- A broad skill set from email to social content
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proactive and self-motivated approach.
- Experience using Adobe Photoshop and video editing software
- Strong attention to detail.
- Naturally curious with a willingness to learn and develop.
- Comfortable receiving feedback and coaching.

This is a hybrid position with 4 days in the office after probation. If you would like to find out more about this position then get in touch ASAP.

title: Media Sales Executive

title: Paid Social Specialist
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Paid Social Specialist to join a growing eCommerce business. Reporting to the Performance Marketing Manager, you will take ownership of global paid social activity across key platforms including Meta, Pinterest, Snapchat and TikTok.

This role sits at the heart of the Performance Marketing team, using data, audience insights and platform expertise to develop and optimise campaigns that drive both brand awareness and commercial performance. You'll collaborate closely with teams across Marketing, Brand, Content, eCommerce and Technology to deliver engaging, high-performing campaigns across international markets.

If you're passionate about paid social, performance marketing, and digital innovation, this could be the perfect next step in your career.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and optimise paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Pinterest.
- Plan and execute campaigns aligned with business objectives, seasonal activity and brand priorities.
- Develop and maintain paid social content calendars.
- Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve ROI and efficiency.
- Work closely with creative and content teams to deliver engaging, platform-specific assets.
- Support audience segmentation, targeting strategies and personalisation initiatives.
- Continuously optimise full-funnel paid social performance.
- Act as the internal subject matter expert for paid social marketing.
- Establish testing frameworks and measure campaign incrementality and brand lift.
- Build strong relationships with platform partners and external agencies.
- Produce regular performance reports, insights and strategic recommendations.
- Present campaign results and optimisation plans to key stakeholders.
- Ensure tracking, pixels, feeds and audience data are correctly implemented and maintained.
- Keep up to date with platform developments, trends and emerging opportunities.
- Support annual planning, forecasting and KPI setting for paid social channels.

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll have:
- Proven experience in a Paid Social, Performance Marketing or Digital Marketing role.
- Strong hands-on expertise with Meta Ads Manager.
- Experience using TikTok, Snapchat and Pinterest advertising platforms.
- Experience managing campaigns across international markets.
- Excellent analytical skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
- Experience with automated and AI-driven campaign types such as Advantage+.
- Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.
- Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
- Excellent organisation and project management abilities.
- A genuine interest in social media, digital marketing and eCommerce.

If you're a data-driven Paid Social specialist looking to make a significant impact in a fast-paced eCommerce environment, we'd love to hear from you. This is a hybrid position.
